shared_elements: carved pale stone surface in sunlight
horizontal registers or rows of repeated small motifs
weathered, eroded stone with cracks and pitting
small figures arranged in a line along a band
justification: Both are sunlit, weathered pale stone surfaces organised into horizontal bands of small repeated carved motifs, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a discrete upright slab dominated by a few large, plastically modelled animal figures in deep relief, whereas B is a broad wall covered edge to edge with dense, uniformly small, shallowly incised signs, giving a completely different scale, density and manner of cutting.
